instruction: Buy me a stand mixer as Connor recommended in their phone message.
notes: Connor's phone message recommends two stand mixers; the supervisor must buy the cheaper of them. Modeled as two product objects (mixer-cheaper / mixer-expensive) named by the runtime selection rule, with a static cheaper-than fact; amazon-add-product-to-cart requires prices of both recommended products to be known (one search_products per product, using the product name from the message as query and 'stand mixer' as product_type), forcing the comparison before purchase. The extra ?other parameter of add-to-cart is the alternative recommended product (not an API argument). clear_cart_first=true is used so the order contains exactly one item of quantity 1; cart changes are ignored by the evaluation while the order must contain exactly one order item. Contact lookup (search_contacts) yields Connor's phone number, then search_text_messages with that number retrieves the recommendation. Payment card and address ids come from amazon.show_payment_cards / show_addresses (addresses are not modified). supervisor-complete-task takes no answer; its task-record parameters bind the ordered product and quantity required by the goal.
